sentences.text: Shri Charchit Shastri - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Apoorv Joshi - Government Advocate for responde

Order 
This first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for grant of bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 18.01.2022 in connection with Crime No.24/2022 registered at Police Station Kshipra, District Indore for offence under Section 376(2)(D), 376(2)(N), 377, 323,
294, 506 and 34 of IPC and under Section 25 of Arms Act.
3. It is submitted by counsel for applicant that there was a dispute between husband and wife and the applicant has been falsely implicated.
The allegations of rape on multiple occasion by the applicant and other accused person has been falsely made.

The applicant is in jail from 18.01.2022.
4.
Per contra, the application is vehemently opposed by counsel for State.

It is submitted by Shri Apoorv Joshi that the bail application of the co- accused Ankesh Baghel, whose case is identical to that of the applicant has NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26842 2 MCRC-25666-2024 already been rejected.
5. Considering the nature of allegations coupled with the fact that the prosecutrix has supported the prosecution case, no case is made out for grant of bail.
